noCard.title: No card required
noCard.body: Start on the free trial without entering any payment details.

firstVideo.title: Your first video is on us
firstVideo.body: {credits} credits when you verify your email, on top of the {trialCredits} trial credits, to use within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. They are given once per person, and they are not available from some connections or with a temporary email address. Trial exports are {resolution} with a watermark.

reviewed.title: Every cut is reviewed
reviewed.body: Every edited cut is scored before you see it; a low score sends it back for another pass. Subtitles, thumbnails and post text are made in a single pass.

refund.title: Our failure, your credits back
refund.body: If a step fails on our side, the credits held for it are refunded.

speed.title: How long it takes
speed.body: Minutes for a small job, sometimes half an hour for a big one.

alpha.title: Public alpha, said plainly
alpha.body: ReelBolt is in public alpha. Expect rough edges; things may change.

samples.title: Real videos, made here
samples.intro: Every video below was made with ReelBolt and is shown with the recipe that made it.
